dayLines.line: 🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 89 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
💬 Lucie says: "If they're watching, let them watch me work. That's all I've got."

💬 Chantal pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
(Chantal has been contacted by an alien player. They don't understand what happened. But they'll warn you when they dream again.)
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
A kite over the treeline. Nobody is holding the string. On its screen, for a frame: you, from above.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A kite with no string, holding station over the trees. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE STATIC KITE! You're on your own.
You fling a handful of grit into its eyes. (pocket_sand: blinded)
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It's circling high above reach — a screen glinting in the sun.
The kite stops dead. Below it, the ground lights up in a grid.

It's high overhead — out of Machete reach. Watch the mark, not the kite.

◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Chantal — Combat 1. Three offers; they took Berserker Rage. Earned, chosen. (rage: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Chantal chose Berserker Rage (rage) at Combat 1.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ava Garcia is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Ava is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
🕯️ Ava Garcia is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Ava kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lucie blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
📖 LEARNED: Night Hunting (Level 1). Hunting at night is not hunting blind. It is hunting by ear, by smell, by patience.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Ava Garcia, 89 days. The mantle passes to Lucie Kikuni.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lucie Kikuni, 29 — a hunter. Her hands know different work now: Bloodhound, Echo Location.
The fire knew Lucie before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — every fire has a theory tonight.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Chantal is calling it "The Ugly Beast." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.
🌿 Brian returns from foraging the wilds: +276 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 276 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.

🔥 The fire settles. Chantal has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Brian breathes "We've been walking past those." Nikos says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💛 You hold Trail compass. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)

💛 You hold Field suture kit. You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to grove.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 12× Muscadine Grapes (1080 kcal). You also gather deadfall: 2× branches. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
(The snare wire becomes the snare — improvised, 2 uses.)
You set a Snare here. Check it tomorrow.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (1080 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 48 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You sow Muscadine Grapes: 365 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 45 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
Chantal will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You clear a dead bed. Sow fresh seed to start a new crop. (40 kcal.)

📋 Chantal — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Brian — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.

Brian leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Sunbasker. Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish. Every uninterrupted turn is a loaded bite."

Dawn's an hour off — too late for real sleep. Rest a while instead, or wait for morning.

🌿 Chantal checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 Chantal pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (588 stone now.)
🪵 Brian hauls back 9 wood. The pile grows. (2590 logs now.)
That night, they bring Ines home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
It's settled. The village is calling it "The Ugly Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +2400 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
The fire is quiet today. Nobody's talking much.
🔍 Nikos crouches over spiky grass tufts in the shallows hiding crisp round corms, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
Nikos is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 76/100)
Chantal came back with 413 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 207 kcal in, 206 kcal eaten at the fire.
Nikos and Brian lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Brian eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
🍽️ Nikos leaves the surplus by the fire for whoever's hungry. "The pantry can't take it. We can."
Chantal spent the afternoon at the workbench and made 5 Crossbow bolt — and carries them now, their own work in their own hands.
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile north caught a Gray Squirrel! About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~639 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
